item.title: How Underage and Adult Users Transition Between Nicotine Products? | #GFN26ScienceLab
item.description: Nicotine use is not static; people move between products, patterns and levels of risk over time. Understanding how both underage and adult users transition matters because regulation can either guide movement away from harm or unintentionally push it in the wrong direction. For young people, prevention and enforcement remain essential. For adults who smoke, the priority should be making sure product transitions lead away from combustion, not back towards it. (Published on August 10, 2026bygfn.tv)
